# AitherConnect

> Browser extension — federated AI search, page context, and the Living OS overlay.

Your agent cannot see the page you are looking at, so you paste it in by hand.

## Install

```
load unpacked — see the repo
```

## Use it in 30 seconds

Install it and ask an agent about the tab you are on.

## Composes with

- [awdk](https://aitherium.github.io/awdk/) — Build AI agent fleets — 3 lines, any backend, local or cloud.

## Where it lives

- Repo: https://github.com/Aitherium/AitherConnect
- Docs: https://aitherium.github.io/AitherConnect/
- Manifest (keys + the one-line adoption story): https://aitherium.github.io/AitherConnect/aither-manifest.json

This repository is mirrored from the AitherOS monorepo by `.github/workflows/sync-connect.yml`; hand edits made here are overwritten on the next sync — change the source instead.

Everything Aitherium, in one file for agents: https://aitherium.com/llms.txt
